dimension.$description: 4-based spacing/sizing scale. Engineers consume via space.* semantic tokens, not these primitives. v0.8 added stops 1_5/7/9/11/14 to close documented gaps surfaced by component contracts.

1_5.$description: Sub-grid 6 px. Pairs with radius.md (6 px) and provides the optical inner-padding tier between 4 and 8. Documented exception per spacing.md §1.

7.$description: v0.8 — Used by Segmented segment height (32 - 2×2 padding) and the deferred Button.xs tier.

9.$description: v0.8 — Used by Switch track width and the cozy density tier (size.control.cozy).

11.$description: v0.8 — Apple HIG minimum touch target. Aliased by size.control.touch.

14.$description: v0.8 — Used by Button.xl (hero pill CTA, added v0.4).

size.$description: Common bounded sizes for layout containers and reading widths. v0.8 re-binds size.control.* to dimension primitives and adds cozy/xl tiers.

ultra.$description: v0.8 — 32" ops monitor reach. Operator-only; not for marketing.

narrow.$description: Satoshi longform body cap (editorial prose). v0.10 — narrowest editorial measure.

default.$description: v0.8 — Typographic sweet spot. .prose-lumen consumes this.

wide.$description: Editorial body cap; wider tolerance for sans body.

xs.$description: v0.9 — 24 px table-row inline action / chip-close / segment cell. Desktop-density only; below the 44 px touch floor.

sm.$description: 32 px — compact button / input height. Linear/Carbon operator default. Desktop-density only.

cozy.$description: v0.8 — 36 px settings-panel sweet spot. Density tier between sm and md. Tab-nav, mood-switcher, library skeletons consume.

md.$description: 40 px — default control height. Lumen Button default size.

touch.$description: 44 px — Apple HIG minimum touch target. Mobile floor.

lg.$description: 48 px — large CTA / form height. Mobile / marketing.

xl.$description: v0.8 — 56 px hero pill CTA. Button.xl tier (added v0.4).

scrollbar.$description: v0.8 — 8 px scrollbar track width. Used in ::-webkit-scrollbar.

sm.$description: v0.8 — 6 px decorative dot (status row indicator).
